title: Bread to Share

readiness.math: sharing equally: division by dealing out (older: with some left over)
readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: Some families have come over the hills from Bellhaven. Times are hard there, and they're hungry.

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: I baked extra rolls. Let's share them out fairly, so each family gets the same.

steps.speaker: tobias
steps.prompt: Share the rolls so each family has the same. One each, round and round.

older.prompt: Share the rolls fairly among four families. If some can't be shared fairly, put them in the left-over bowl.

outro.speaker: tobias
outro.text: Jesus fed a great crowd with five loaves and two fish. We can only share a little, but sharing is how love grows.

journal_line: I shared rolls fairly among families who came over the hills.
unavailable_text: The rolls are shared for today.
